Request your spot → What it is

The first stop. Small on purpose.

Where it starts.

The first-ever Future Courts gathering — an intimate afternoon of pickleball: easy to pick up, impossible not to enjoy. A curated handful of founders, operators and the growth & go-to-market people building what’s next in Tokyo. A couple of hours on court, then drinks together. The start of the community — whoever’s early is part of the inner circle.

The venue

Sansan Pickleball Court.

Tokyo’s first large-scale dedicated pickleball facility — seven courts across indoor and rooftop, plus a lounge, coworking space and showers, three minutes from Higashi-Ikebukuro. Built by Sansan to spark new connections — which is rather the point.

Play once.
Belong everywhere.
